messages:
maria: Quick sync: we're seeing a small but noisy class of customers still POSTing `old_schema` in the request envelope. Router validation now fails them.
kevin: We introduced strict validation in the last deploy; unfortunate but expected. What's the cheapest operational fix?
ana: Gateway shim is fastest if we can do a pattern scan for `"old_schema"` in the byte stream. Avoid JSON parsing unless the pattern matches.
olivia: If we do that, can we also add header-based opt-in? `X-Compat-Fallback: legacy` so customers who can change do so.
josh: We should be careful with streaming: any cloning will copy the request body buffer and could double memory. Make rewrite step as early and minimal as possible.
sam: I'd rather avoid sidecar for now. It adds latency and more things to deploy. Gateway FF per-tenant seems doable.
kevin: Implementation sketch: (1) memchr-like search for `"old_schema"` in the raw bytes; (2) if found, run a minimal streaming JSON transform to rename key to `payload`; (3) compute canonical cache key after transform; (4) emit `legacy_detected=true` metric with timing.
maria: For telemetry, we should annotate traces and add `gateway.legacy_rewrite_ms`. Also surface tenant ID for internal dashboards (no PII).
nana: For safety, keep a kill-switch FF global to turn shim off if we see regression. Also make the FF targetable to tenant IDs.
kevin: Tests: unit raw-search, property test for partial matches across buffer boundaries, integration streaming test to ensure SSE chunking unaffected. Perf: 5k req/s perf run with 10% legacy mix.
olivia: Comms: draft an email template + migration guide. Include curl samples and SDK patches.
josh: Cache note: normalized payload must be deterministic. Use canonical JSON marshalling with sorted keys for cache key hash. That ensures old/new produce the same key.
sam: Good. Also ensure we don't change semantics: e.g., arrays vs single objects. Validate shape after rewrite. If post-rewrite validation fails, return 400 and log with hashed payload.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled gate rollout 2026-04-07T16:00Z, canary tenants T-42,T-314 at 1%.
maria: timeline proposal: enable auto-detect for 60 days, send migration notices at 30 and 10 days, then flip to header-only opt-in for another 30 days before removal.
kevin: I'll own the gateway PR + perf run. Maria can own comms and RFC. Nana, can you add the observability dashboards and graphs?
nana: yep, will add a panel for per-tenant p50 and `gateway.legacy_rewrite_ms`.
kevin: quick question: should the rewrite be idempotent? If request already has `payload` and `old_schema`, prefer `payload` and drop `old_schema` to avoid ambiguity.
maria: yes, deterministic rules: prefer `payload` if present, else rewrite `old_schema` -> `payload`. Document the rule.
kevin: cool. Starting branch `gateway/legacy-rewrite` now.
